crossRefs.note: “Or if I bring a sword on that land, and say, ‘Sword, go through the land; so that I cut off from it man and animal;’
He called for a famine on the land. He destroyed the food supplies.
They blew the three hundred trumpets, and Yahweh set every man’s sword against his fellow and against all the army; and…
Saul and all the people who were with him were gathered together, and came to the battle; and behold, they were all…
For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of Mount Seir to utterly kill and destroy them.…
I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms. I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the nations. I will overthrow…

translations.web: I will call for a sword against him to all my mountains,” says the Lord Yahweh. “Every man’s sword will be against his brother.
translations.bsb: And I will summon a sword against Gog on all My mountains, declares the Lord GOD, and every man’s sword will be against his brother.
translations.kjv: And I will call for a sword against him throughout all my mountains, saith the Lord GOD: every man's sword shall be against his brother.
translations.asv: And I will call for a sword against him unto all my mountains, saith the Lord Jehovah: every man's sword shall be against his brother.
